description: Unleash a joyful audio experience with the boAt Airdopes Joy v2, crafted to bring seamless rhythm to your everyday life. Your musical journey kicks off with up to 35 hours of total playtime, giving you plenty of juice to power through your weekly commutes, podcast binging, and favorite series without intermission. Designed for maximum portability, its sleek and pocketable design effortlessly slips into your pocket or bag, making it the ultimate travel companion. When you're running low on time, the legendary 10 mins ASAP™ Charge gives you a quick 120 mins of playtime, ensuring you're never left stranded in silence. Once plugged in, the massive 13mm drivers with boAt Signature Sound take over, unleashing a deep, bass-rich performance that transforms your playlist into a high-energy concert. Navigating your audio is entirely effortless using the Easy Touch Controls, allowing you to answer calls or skip tracks with simple taps while on the move. Communication stays perfectly crisp via 2 Mics with ENx™ Technology, which filters out background chaos so your voice comes through clearly during outdoor calls. For gamers, switching to BEAST™ Mode unlocks 50ms low latency, aligning every sound effect perfectly with the onscreen action. Getting started is instant thanks to IWP™ (Insta Wake N’ Pair) technology, which connects to your phone the second you open the case, while IPX5 splash and sweat resistance keeps your earbuds protected against sudden rain and heavy workouts. To make the experience uniquely yours, the boAt Hearables App Support lets you monitor system health, check pairing status, and run quick device diagnostics directly from your smartphone, solving your everyday usage hassles. Step up your daily soundtrack and let the Airdopes Joy v2 bring your pocket-sized audio world to life!
